updates.title: Purview Network Data Security: DLP Integration with Entra Global Secure Access Now GA
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview's Data Loss Prevention now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to enforce DLP policies at the network layer, protecting sensitive data across browsers, apps, APIs, and AI platforms. This capability enables admins to detect risky user activity and block unauthorized sharing of sensitive data with untrusted cloud applications in real time.

updates.title: 14 Authorization Vulnerabilities Patched in Microsoft Edge (Chromium)
updates.summary: Microsoft Edge has patched 14 Chromium-based authorization vulnerabilities spanning multiple components including WakeLock, WebView, Navigation, Scroll, NFC, Safebrowsing, Core, Contextual Tasks, Network, BrowserTag, DevTools, and Extensions. Admins should update Edge immediately to mitigate potential privilege escalation and unauthorized access risks.
